## Contents

## Overview[]

This section highlights various recurring and faction-based events in the game. Players can engage in these events to earn rewards, compete with others, and contribute to their alliances.

For more info see: Apocalypse Guide

## List of Events[]

### Attack on Titan[]

Description: Join the zombie siege campaign and defend the shelter against a giant Titan threat.
Key Features:

Replayability: This event can be replayed with new task sets for rewards. [...] Description: Compete to earn points by using resources and accelerating progress.
Mechanics:

Faction Buffs: Similar rewards and mechanics apply, with buffs rotating between factions.
Rewards: Includes jackpots, ranking rewards, and milestone bonuses.
Replayability: This event recurs, giving players repeated opportunities to rank and earn.
